offering_description.value: The company supplies ethylene to manufacturers of plastics and other chemical derivatives. It produces ethylene through OpCo by converting ethane at its production facilities.

quotes.quote: Ethylene is a key building block used to produce a number of key derivatives, including polyethylene (“PE”) and polyvinyl chloride (“PVC”). These derivatives are used in a wide variety of end markets including packaging, construction and transportation, which in turn make life better for people every day. Like our parent company, Westlake, we are a quality manufacturer and dependable global supplier of ethylene.

Westlake Chemical Partners assets include: multiple ethylene production facilities, which primarily convert ethane into ethylene, with an annual capacity of approximately 3.4 billion pounds and a 200-mile ethylene pipeline.
